Brantone Electronics browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Brantone Electronics Blue Meanie - Germanium Fuzz Published on January 9, 2020 Brantone Electronics fuzz foot-controlled pedal Information Brantone Electronics The 'Blue Meanie' Professional Germanium fuzz pedal is the pinnacle of the Brantone range and features some very rare & literally impossible to obtain components that were found in the very first Tone Benders of the mid to late '60s. Sound-wise it's just incredible...a classic huge, fat, sickly germanium wall of fuzz tone that's enough to please any fuzz head. With sustaining notes that last forever and a central 'bass cut' control the tones are endless. With a bit of time spent tweaking the controls, there's something here for every guitarist. Based on the 1970s MK3 tone bender, this is the only fuzz pedal you will ever need.
